laws.rule: Faro city charges a municipal tourist tax of EUR 2 per guest per night (about A$3.18, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) from 1 March to 31 October and EUR 1 from November to February, for guests aged 16 and over, up to 7 consecutive nights.
